name: Emontx → Pause
description: Suspend or resume processing of the UART by the EmonTx hub. While paused, the hub does not read any bytes from the UART and `emontx.send_command` is ignored, so another component sharing the same UART can take exclusive ownership of it, for example a [Serial Proxy](https://esphome.io/components/serial_proxy/) used to flash or debug the EmonTx from a computer.
